items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And later on around 1924, 25 like that, he would take me out on jobs and he would leave me sit down and sit down and play.

ctx.x: And later on around 1924, 25 like that, he would take me out on jobs and he would leave me sit down and sit down and play. And I played myself with George Lewis and D.D. and Billy on drums. Did you tell us yet when you started trumpet? You played drums a long time then. Well just off and on, just filling in. You were 17. 1927 I started playing trumpet in 1927. He was my teacher there. He was my teacher there. He was stuff with with George Lewis and Dee Dee and Billy on drums. Did you tell us yet when you started…
How long did you stay with him?
